narrative.overview:
A monograph about real inventory. The page opens on one real house full-bleed with its entry price in the headline, a black colofon strip states how many houses exist and where, and each house is a white plate: large photo beside a data column, alternating sides. Palette, glass panels, grid of lines and nodes and pills come from the official Propyte brand manual (2026).

Density is calm and legible: large Inter display type, DM Sans text, Space Grotesk for details and figures. Aqua is rare and sits on Aztec; light areas are Tech White and Water Dew. The same system is the family base for all nine /lp/* landings; each landing keeps its own idea around its photo and its figure.
keyCharacteristics: Aztec dark with New Aqua accent, Tech White ground
Photo full-bleed cover with Aztec veil and node grid
Colofon strip of live counts that doubles as the city filter
Glass request sheet in the first viewport, mobile included
All pressables are pills; sentence case everywhere; no exit links

rules.name: The Live Figure Rule
rules.body: Every number on screen is computed from the live inventory; a missing value says Confirmar, never a guess.

rules.name: The Aqua On Dark Rule
rules.body: New Aqua carries meaning only on Aztec, the veil or the gradient. It never sets text on a light surface.

rules.name: The Brand Gradient Rule
rules.body: The one gradient is Aztec to Deep Onyx to Dull Teal to Retro Cyan at 170deg, on the closing section. The cover uses an Aztec veil, not a second gradient.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: No uppercase tracked labels anywhere; small text is Space Grotesk at normal tracking.

rules.name: The Glass Is For Data Rule
rules.body: Blur glass is reserved for the request sheet (Aztec glass) and the data table (Water Dew glass).

rules.name: The Pill Rule
rules.body: Anything the visitor can press is a 999px pill; surfaces that hold content are 14, 22 or 28px.

dos: Do keep every figure (price, down payment, counts, ranges) derived from live inventory; where the developer did not declare a value print the muted 'Confirmar' note in Dull Teal.
Do keep zero exit links except legal ones; 'choose this house' scrolls to the form and preselects the house.
Do keep the request form visible in the first viewport, including mobile (Nombre field measured at about 760px on 390x844).
Do write labels in sentence case at normal tracking; the form's tracked uppercase label style is neutralised inside the glass sheet.
Do use New Aqua as text only on Aztec, the Aztec veil or the closing gradient; on light surfaces use Aztec or Dull Teal.
Do pill every pressable control (999px), round large surfaces at 22px (plates 28px) and nested data panels at 14px.
Do recolor the shared form through CSS variables on the sheet wrapper, never by forking the component.
Do paint the grid of lines and nodes as a background-image at 25% #D8ECE9, masked to fade toward the left.
Do pair the cover photo with the house the headline price names (entry house that has a photo).
Do take icons only from the custom Propyte icon set once it exists as SVG.
donts: Don't use uppercase tracked eyebrows or kickers above blocks.
Don't split the first view 50/50 with a dark form panel, build grids of identical cards, or number steps 01/02/03.
Don't invent urgency (counters, 'quedan 2') or testimonials, and don't name developments or developers.
Don't hardcode prices or counts in copy.
Don't use hard offset shadows; depth is glass, veil and soft ambient shadow only.
Don't use Aureoline Yellow or Bright Pastel Green on these landings; they belong to Propyte MX and Propyte Market.
Don't treat Lucide as the system's icon language; it is a placeholder.
Don't add new !important overrides; the ones on the form shell are inherited debt.
